entries.what: The Cloud Functions Node.js 18 runtime passed its decommission date of 2025-10-30, and Node.js 16 and older before it. New deploys and updates on them are refused, and deployed functions may be disabled, so the page only says "may" about a function that's already running.

source.quote: you can no longer create new workloads or update

lookFor: Node.js 18 chosen for a Cloud Function: engines.node in the package.json beside firebase-functions, a runtime of nodejs18 in firebase.json or a gcloud --runtime flag. Not engines of an app that only calls a function, and not AWS Lambda's nodejs18.x.
entries.replacement: nodejs24, supported until the page's later dates, or nodejs22 until its own.
requires: Set engines.node, or the runtime in firebase.json, then redeploy every function. firebase-functions and firebase-admin may need a newer major to run on it.
